entries.title: Sister Cities Commission
entries.who_it_is_for: The Sister Cities Commission meets the fourth Thursday of every month. The mission of the Sister Cities program, and the MSSC, is to "promote peace through mutual respect, understanding and cooperation - one individual, one community at a time."
entries.what_to_do: At Public Safety Building Conference Room, 300 Spruce Street Morgantown WV 26505.
